name: YouTube channel research desk: transcripts, AI summaries, digest and chat in Google Sheets with Apify

parameters.content:
## YouTube channel research desk: transcripts, summaries, digest and chat in Google Sheets

### How it works
For researchers, marketers and creators who follow YouTube channels. Every morning it sends the channels, playlists and videos in your Sources tab to the YouTube Transcript Scraper actor on Apify, which reads each video's caption track. Only new uploads come back, so each video is fetched and paid for once. Each video becomes one row in the Videos tab: title, channel, date, views, likes, chapters and the transcript with [m:ss] marks. Videos that can't be read go to the Failed tab with a reason code. Every run adds a Run log row with counts and the exact charge. Optional: an AI model writes a 5-line summary, key points with timestamps, topics and a "worth watching" note; a digest of new videos goes to your email, Slack or Discord; and a chat answers questions from your transcripts with links to the moment.

### Setup
1. Make a Google Sheet with four tabs: Sources, Videos, Failed, Run log. In Sources, type Link in A1 and Label in B1, then add links below.
2. Create an Apify account (free plan works). Add a Header Auth credential: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`. Select it in the four Apify nodes.
3. Connect Google Sheets and Gmail credentials. If a Sheets node shows Map Each Column Manually, set it back to Map Automatically.
4. In Settings, paste the sheet link and your email.
5. Click Execute workflow, check the tabs, then activate.

The actor is published by SKILLMERC, who made this template.

### Customization
Set useAI to true and add a model credential to get summaries. Swap the OpenAI model node for Anthropic or Gemini. Enable the Slack or Discord node instead of Gmail.

## What a run costs
The actor charges USD 1.00 per 1,000 transcripts on Apify's free plan, less on paid plans. Failed or skipped videos are free. 5 channels posting 2 videos a day each: USD 0.30 a month. maxCostPerRunUsd caps each run. AI calls bill your model account.

## 1. Start and settings
Daily at 07:00, by hand, from the form (adds a source) or from the chat (asks a question). Settings holds every value you change.

## 2. Add a source from the form
Checks the link is a YouTube channel, playlist or video and adds it to the Sources tab once. The next run picks it up.

## 3. Collect new transcripts
One Apify run for all sources, capped by maxItemsPerRun and maxCostPerRunUsd. Only new videos come back. The run is checked every 30 seconds until it ends, so long runs never time out. Type no in an Active column to pause a source.

## 4. Understand (optional)
Runs only when useAI is true. Long transcripts are cut to evenly spaced one-minute parts that fit maxAiCharacters, so the summary covers the whole video.

## 5. Store in Google Sheets
Videos and Failed are updated by Video ID, so running twice never adds a duplicate. Every run, failed or not, adds one Run log row.

## 6. Tell
One message per run with the new videos. Nothing is sent when nothing is new. Gmail is on; to use Slack or Discord, enable that node and disable Gmail.

## 7. Ask your channels
Open the chat and ask a question. It searches the transcripts in your sheet, no vector database needed, and answers with links that open the video at that minute. Long videos are searched up to the sheet cell limit.
Paste your Google Sheet link and email in Settings before the first run.
